aiTitle: Friday Prep and the Porto Flight

message.content: Hi. I need to send a quick email to my parents. They're coming to visit for Easter, but I want to make sure they know I've sorted the transport.

content.text: I can help with that. Do you want to confirm you've booked the train, or are you telling them you've already got the tickets? Also, what time do they expect to arrive?

message.content: I've booked the train. Just tell them I've got the tickets and to meet me at the station. Oh, and mention that I'm heading to Porto for the long weekend after they leave, so I'll be busy that week.

content.text: Got it. Here is a draft: "Hi Mum and Dad, just letting you know I've booked the train tickets. Please meet me at the station when you arrive. I'm off to Porto for Easter, so I'll be away for the week after you leave. See you soon!" Does that sound right?

message.content: Yes, that's perfect. Send it. Now, while you're at it, can you check if I need to do anything about my choir rehearsal? I'm worried I might miss it.

content.text: Let me check your calendar. You have choir on Tuesday evening. Your section leader, James Wright, hasn't sent any cancellation notices today. Would you like me to set a reminder for you to pack your choir folder before you head to the station?

message.content: Yes, please. And while we're talking about the trip, I need to sort out the flight details. Can you look up the check-in times for my flight to Porto?

content.text: I've found your booking. Online check-in opens 24 hours before departure. Your flight is on the 15th, so you can check in tonight. Do you want me to add a reminder to do that tonight?

message.content: Yes, please. Also, I need to pick up some ingredients for Sunday dinner. Can you add chicken, potatoes, and carrots to my Ocado cart?

content.text: I've added those items to your Ocado cart. The estimated delivery is Sunday between 8am and 12pm. Is that still okay, or do you want to shift it to Saturday?

message.content: Saturday is better. I'll be back from the station by Friday evening. Please change the delivery to Saturday morning if possible.

content.text: I've updated your Ocado delivery slot to Saturday morning, 8am-12pm. Is there anything else you need help with before you head out?
